notes.title: Cards
notes.notes:
Community items are published.
Badges, cards, backgrounds, avatars and emoticons.
For those who have played for a while, the items should be given automatically into the steam inventory.

I've been resting for the last few days after intensive release weeks, making these cards, sketching out a manual in word, etc.
Now I'm preparing a patch.

notes.title: Small Patch 12.03.2023
notes.notes:
- Reworked Hardcore and Normal modes
- Fixed the flashback bug on the Tower. There was no any effect on its start in the latest build
- Logical inaccuracy with the transition to the chapter 1 locations from the prologue and chapter 2 fixed
- Some borders on some levels was added
- Completely fixed the inventory issue on the last level
- HUD for snow goggles was added. (It can be turned off in the HUD options menu)
Some more minor fixes and additions.

[b]I remind you don't have to start a new game after updates if you don't want to.[/b]
You can choose the version on which were made your saves in Beta Versions section on the game's preferences on Steam to continue playing through.

notes.title: First week results
notes.notes:
[h1]The results[/h1]
So the first week after the release of the game is over. Those were incredibly emotional days.
During this short period I had to do a lot of work on the game.
At least one patch with fixes was released every day. But usually there were several of them per day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41629661/898c48282eac0c593c64d676fc032fd8d39ecab9.png[/img]
[i]Screenshot from the community. Author: Keizuka.[/i]

[b]Thank you for your bug reports![/b]
During the first two days of the release, all critical and most serious errors were fixed.
Then there were patches that fixed the remaining important problems and many minor flaws.
Some content was also added.
English localisation has been corrected as well.

I partially shared the patchnotes on the discord server: https://discord.gg/uf7F5SbFMG
You can share your impressions of the game, ask your questions and report bugs there, in the Steam community or in any of my DMs that you find.

[h1]A bit about the plans[/h1]
Now major updates with new content are planned.
[list]
[*] New levels will be added and the old ones will be supplemented.
[*] The story will be expanded.
[*] New enemies, weapons and equipment will appear.
[*] Some mechanics will also be improved, mainly weather and radio.
[/list]
A lot has been cut out for the release, so the development of updates will not take as long as it may seem.

[h1]Your saves[/h1]
[i]They don't work on updated versions of the game due to the specifics of the GZDoom engine.[/i]

[b][Solution][/b]
So I publish old versions of the game. You can find them in the "Beta-versions" section in Steam's game preferences. You can easily find the version on which your saves were made and continue playing on it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41629661/63dc39ebabf0c3315ce4c8d9b5e199c47ca5f73b.png[/img]

[h1]Linux version[/h1]
A Linux version was also published.

notes.title: First 2 days fixes
notes.notes:
As I said earlier, the development of the game right after the release is only getting more intensified.

During the first two days of the release, most of the major bugs were fixed.
In the following days, more minor corrections will be introduced until the very end of the weekend.
After that, I will focus on major content updates, which are also coming pretty soon.

notes.notes:
! Your saves for sure will be corrupted after update.

You can find them in Beta-versions section in game's preferences on Steam.

notes.title: Delay.
notes.notes:
The new release date: March 1, 2023.

Although, it is absolutely not okay to do so two days before the scheduled date, but I have to delay the release. 

The reason is my inexperience as a developer/publisher. As you understand, this is my first Steam release, excluding the demo. And I face a lot of nuances for the first time. So, I’ve sent the game’s build to Steam for verification too late. About Feb 12-13. Now it’s obvious that they just won 't check it in time. And even if they do, after that may appear problems that cannot be solved in the remaining day or two. And announcing the delay on the day of the release would be even more wrong than today.

The demo, by the way, was checked in the shortest possible time, although it came out for the festival, when, the Steam administration was more loaded, I thought. So I hoped for the speed of their work.

The release of the game will shift by 12 days, until March 1.
In theory, I could have moved it literally for a couple of days. But, firstly, fewer people would have had time to find out about the news.
Secondly, I would have had to come out under several major releases. 
And thirdly, it is not known how long the verification will last. Extra 12 days, I think, would be enough in any case.

In general, the news is extremely unpleasant, but there is no other way.

On the other hand,
A lot of content that I’ve planned to add with updates after the release, will be in the game already at the start. Also 12 days of an extra polishing and tests will be really good for the quality of the game.

In general, the new release date is 
March 1 (19:00 PST-time).

notes.title: Demo Update. Hardcore
notes.notes:
-Hardcore implies on checkpoints.
 After load you will spawn at the last active checkpoint. Even though, your saved progress will not be lost 
 after that.

-In both modes(Hardcore and Normal) you will lose the points of your maximum health after each death. 
 However, you can recover that.

-The flashlight on the Overpass-level was fixed. Now it warks there.

-Has been added a new item.

-Were fixed a radio control bug.
 Before the player was able to control a cassette-block(by pressing arrow-keys) even after exiting the 
 radio-menu. It made a keyboard-view impossible when radio turned on.

-Fixed a hardtack exploit. 
 Now you can't drop it from your inventory.

-Transition between levels is more smooth now.

Other changes and small additions.

On the picture is an old game's cover-image. It was on game's page on Steam before the ~March 2022 :)

notes.title: Your saves
notes.notes:
! Your saves for sure will be corrupted after update. 
So, if you don't want to update the game and lose your saves you should save your current version of the game by copying the game's files into the another folder and run it from there, ignoring updates.
